description: GaWF-aligned RNN behavioral control: identity inner activation and the LayerNorm/ReLU/dropout output fed back as the next recurrent state, ten seeds.

dependency_strategy.smoke: DSW GPU3 seed1, two epochs, passed
dependency_strategy.task_map: GPU4 runs seeds 1,3,5,7,9; GPU5 runs seeds 2,4,6,8,10
dependency_strategy.amarel_handoff: 61760273 and 61760274 cancelled after DSW formal seeds1-2 entered epoch 1

notes: Formal hyperparameters reuse the old RNN setting exactly: hidden_size=275, lr=0.001, weight_decay=1e-5, cnn_dropout=0.0, rnn_dropout=0.5, AdamW, 150 epochs, patience=0, seeds 1-10.
Core equation: pre_t=W_ih x_t+b_ih+W_hh h_(t-1)+b_hh; h_t=dropout(ReLU(LayerNorm(pre_t))). h_t is both the layer output and the next recurrent state; there is no inner tanh.
The model key and checkpoint stem are rnn_inloop_notanh, intentionally distinct from the cancelled out-of-loop rnn_notanh control.

A two-epoch seed-1 smoke on DSW 8095 GPU3 completed in about 6 minutes 21 seconds and emitted exactly one model, metrics JSON, and history pickle. Its observed GPU-memory peak was 41,550 MiB of 46,068 MiB.
Each formal unit also exports reset-excluded 32-frame behavioral test accuracy after training; no activation, net-current, ANOVA, or other downstream analysis is scheduled.
Submission gate passed locally: bash -n, launcher --dry-run, pytest experiments/tests/test_amarel_submit_safety.py and experiments/tests/test_clutter_nonlinearity_variants.py (24 passed).

DSW 8095 preflight matched source stamp 988ee1b, all six 40h data-file byte sizes, the cloned torch 2.4.1+cu121 environment, model import, absent result targets, and initially idle GPUs3-5. The node-local /mnt/workspace filesystem had about 58.8 GB free before launch.

GPU3 acquired a new external approximately 11.1 GB process after the smoke ended, so formal uses only GPUs4-5. Each formal writer used about 39.0 GB at epoch-1 startup; no occupied external GPU was used or stopped.
